verdict.rationale: Alma's O-1A founders page states the O-1 'can serve as a foundation for a later EB-1A or EB-2 NIW green card petition, since much of the same evidence carries forward.' It also publishes dedicated EB-1 and EB-2 NIW self-petition guides, and its homepage assessment ranks O-1A alongside an EB-1A self-petition. Together these document the O-1 as a path to a green card rather than a dead end. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the actual O-1-to-green-card transition (timing, sequencing, how evidence is reused), published pricing for the EB-1A/NIW continuation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
